m5_package.purpose: Install and validate the M5 descriptor, worklist, verification spec, context profiles, prompt package, design documents, and mechanism smoke. No compiler implementation source is allowed in this slice.

surface_core_pipeline.purpose: Add/register canonical M5 surface/core passes and integrate the VC4Tile candidate runner so ergonomic inputs flow through surface canonicalization, copy planning, core CFG legalization, core verification, VC4Tile-to-SSAVC4, SSAVC4-to-VC4, and bundle emission.

tile_layout_precision.purpose: Define tile/layout/role/precision vocabulary for ergonomic VC4Tile, with 32-bit-only executable semantics and strict diagnostics for sub-32 forms.

vdr_vcd_lower_half.purpose: Add lower-half SSAVC4 VDR/VCD global-to-VPM load support so the M5 copy planner can choose hardware-natural global-to-shared paths.

copy_planner.purpose: Implement the first VC4Tile copy planner and ergonomic movement ops for global/register/shared movement, views, subviews, transpose views, and shared tile allocation.

global_register_movement.purpose: Prove ergonomic global/register tile load/store patterns with tail masks, 2D row-major indexing, and supported affine stride behavior on real hardware.

shared_vpm_transpose.purpose: Make shared VPM copy and shared transpose ergonomic while lowering to concrete VPM/VDR/VDW/barrier paths.

scf_surface_composition.purpose: Prove supported scf.for/scf.if composition with ergonomic tile ops; surface ops must plan first and SCF/index must disappear before SSAVC4 lowering.

metadata_roles.purpose: Add semantic metadata for roles, boundary policies, resource intent, copy stages, and reuse hints; consume, preserve, or reject every accepted field deterministically.

elementwise_compute.purpose: Add ergonomic tile_fill/broadcast/add/sub/mul/select and optional fma, lower to concrete vector/scalar core arithmetic, and prove on hardware.

tile_reductions.purpose: Add ergonomic tile/warp/block reductions that lower to existing rotate/reduce/shared/barrier mechanisms with input-dependent hardware proofs.

tile_contracts.purpose: Add tile_contract, tile_dot, and tile_matmul as future producer-facing ergonomic surface contracts and lower small 32-bit forms to movement, elementwise, and reduction operations.

m5_final_acceptance.purpose: Prove the M5 ergonomic VC4Tile milestone is complete, scoped, candidate-first, hardware-backed, and regression-clean.

notes: M5 context profiles intentionally avoid unsupported include kind "glob"; every context include is a file or failure artifact so the context packer does not drop slice-relevant material.
